_comment: Example config for the stock_xlsx_importer module. Copy to clients/<client_name>/stock_xlsx_importer.json and edit the values for your business.
_catalog_option_a_note: Option A: point at a Lifong-style stock.json (nested categories). Uses bundled default loader.
_catalog_option_b_note: Option B (alternative): leave stock_catalog_path null and inject a Python callable at init time that returns {SKU_UPPER: {name, stock_unit}}. Use this for clients with custom catalogue formats.
_qty_header_keywords_note: Headers (in scan order) searched to find the QUANTITY column in the xlsx. Default covers EN + ZH typical manifest headers.
_mid_header_tokens_note: First-column values that mark a mid-file header row (skipped, not treated as data). Handles multi-batch xlsx files like the Lifong manufacturer manifest.
